newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber slightly down on Tokyo's fall.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber slightly down on Tokyo's fall.

text.p: Malaysian rubber market was slightly lower at midday with an easier Tokyo market and lack of factors at the start of the week dampening activity.
Dealers said the market is keenly awaiting the return of consumers who have stayed away because of unattractive prices.
"Prices have dropped a lot and we expect buyers from both Asia and Europe to come back," a dealer said, adding that the market was particularly waiting for fresh inquiries from China and Japan.
Trading houses offered SMR CV at 326 cents, SMR L at 305, SMR 10 at 255 and drum latex at 224.

At midday close, Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted June RSS Ones buyer at 269.50 cents ($1.07) a kg, unchanged from Friday's close. June SMR 20 buyer slipped half a cent to 254.50 cents.
Dealers said supply is gradually flowing into the market as the wintering period was over.
